events.diff:
+name: CI
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+  pull_request:
+
+jobs:
+  test:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v5
+
+      - name: Install dependencies
+        run: uv sync # .python-version pins 3.12
+
+      - name: Lint
+        run: uv run ruff check .
+
+      - name: Format check
+        run: uv run ruff format --check .
+
+      - name: Test
+        run: uv run pytest
+
+      - name: Report build metrics
+        if: always()
+        run: |
+          curl -sf -X POST https://agentmon-ci.fly.dev/metrics \
+            -d "repo=$GITHUB_REPOSITORY&sha=$GITHUB_SHA&ref=$GITHUB_REF_NAME&run=$GITHUB_RUN_ID" || true
